filterGuide.title: Tell the system which data to understand?
filterGuide.lead: You just connected a new data source. Before anything enters the knowledge base, EverRoom's filter judges each item — "is this worth keeping?" — and your preference tells it directly: what content should be understood, and what can be ignored.
filterGuide.leadExample: Preferences are injected into every filter decision (highest priority). Writing them clearly greatly reduces false blocks and misses; skipping is fine too — the filter falls back to generic rules and learns your taste over time.
filterGuide.exampleTitle: Example (feel free to follow this format)
filterGuide.example:
Understand (keep):
- Decisions, tasks and project discussions in work email — even short ones
- Project context attached to calendar events
- Anything with concrete facts, numbers or conclusions

Ignore (filter out):
- Marketing, promotions, newsletter templates
- Pure notifications (delivered receipts, auto-replies, verification codes)
- Order confirmations, shipping updates
filterGuide.editTitle: Your filter preference (saved merged with the current one)
filterGuide.placeholder: Write what the system should and should not understand…
